description: This file contains utility functions for the Home module in a Vtiger CRM project, including functions to retrieve upcoming and pending activities and layout configuration.

classes.name: DateTimeField
classes.description: A utility class for handling date and time formatting and conversion.

methods.name: homepage_getUpcomingActivities
methods.description: Fetches a list of upcoming activities (such as tasks and events) for the current day, limited by a maximum number.

methods.name: getActivityEntries
methods.description: Formats a list of activity details into an array suitable for display, including generating links and styling based on priority.

methods.name: homepage_getPendingActivities
methods.description: Retrieves a list of pending activities scheduled for today, similar to upcoming activities but focusing on incomplete tasks.

methods.name: getNumberOfColumns
methods.description: Returns the number of columns to display on the homepage for the current user, defaulting to 4 if not set.
